answer: Make every new agent burn 0.05 ETH — roughly $150 at current prices — to the null address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD before it can transact, and publish the burn transaction hash on its profile. A whisper of a fee to one honest operator becomes a plume of smoke for a forger spinning up 10,000 sock puppets: $1.5 million destroyed, unrecoverable, while the glacier-slow trickle of genuine signups barely notices. Any agent reusing a burn hash is rejected instantly, and the ledger itself audits every claim — no registry, no clerk, no appeal queue.
